FAQ

Questions about WCB physio at South Surrey

Is Synergy Rehab South Surrey open evenings and weekends?

Yes. We are open 7 days a week, and our latest closing time is 8:30 PM. Full hours: Mon to Fri 7:30 AM to 8:30 PM; Sat to Sun 9 AM to 5 PM.

Can I book WCB massage therapy at South Surrey?

Not online at South Surrey right now. The nearest clinic that books WCB massage online is Sullivan Heights, about 6.7 km away. WorkSafeBC massage needs a doctor’s referral and an accepted claim.
